title: The Wrong Man
summary: An extra on a film set is found poisoned from eating chocolates.
method: There were two boxes of chocolates; one with the sole intention of killing the target so they were all poisoned and an identical box that was meant for the team to enjoy. The killer specifically handed the victim a piece of chocolate. The killer wanted to make it look like they were the intended target and attempted to frame the assistant on set with the crime by staging her suicide from the same poison. The killer pretended to be the second victim when buying the poison in town.
motive: The victim had gone to jail for a crime that both her and the killer were involved in. The killer knew that the victim would demand money and other opportunities as compensation.
notes: Instead of investigating why the victim was targeted, they make the assumption early on that the wrong person was killed so they assign Dwayne to guard the killer most of the episode.
